races.display_title: Racing Again November 19th Beginners Chase
races.verdict: WHISPERING WILLOW underperformed over hurdles last time but had previously shaped well over fences and is worth chancing back in this sphere with first-time cheekpieces applied. In-form hurdler Might Be The One is feared most if transferring that ability to fences with Kimy also respected after a promising chase debut at Tramore. WHISPERING WILLOW (IRE) MIGHT BE THE ONE (IRE) KIMY (FR)

races.verdict: STONEYFORD LADY scored over C&D last year and bounced back from a Ballinrobe fall with a good second at Killarney last month. She looks sure to make a bold bid now returned to this venue. Listowel chase winner Potters Pal is open to further improvement on debut for a new yard with Aurea Fortuna also respected after bouncing back to form last time. STONEYFORD LADY (IRE) POTTERS PAL (FR) AUREA FORTUNA (IRE)

races.verdict: An interesting maiden. EASTERN ROCK shaped better than the distance beaten suggests on his hurdling debut at Fontwell last month, paying the price for a big move into contention, and looks sure to build on that promise. Ivor Bear was no match for a speedier sort on his first go over hurdles at this course recently but can be expected to improve upped in trip, while multiple-winning Irish pointer Supreme Force also commands plenty of respect for an in-form stable. EASTERN ROCK (IRE) IVOR BEAR (IRE) SUPREME FORCE (IRE)
